use_cases: Decorative animated background for creative portfolios and landing pages
Interactive art demonstration for teaching generative algorithms
Nature-themed visual element for wellness or environmental products

ai_summary: A canvas-based generative art component that simulates organic tree growth using probability-based branching algorithms. Features elegant trunk and branch mechanics with warm natural color palettes, continuous growth animations, and L-system-inspired generation patterns. Self-contained component suitable as a decorative animated element for creative portfolios, landing pages, or educational demonstrations.
